content.short: Saros is a multi-purpose DeFi protocol on Solana.
content.description: Saros Finance is a DeFi protocol built on the Solana blockchain. It is supported by notable investors. The protocol provides three main products: SarosFarm for automated market making, SarosStake for staking, and SarosSwap for swapping. It also includes SarosSnapshot, a tool that helps traders monitor market competition and evaluate liquidity and activity across pools. Together, these components are designed to streamline DeFi trading and yield opportunities for users on Solana.

resources.tldr: Streaming rewards only to liquidity sitting at the market price, rather than spraying them across the whole curve. A direct answer to incentives that buy depth nobody trades against.
